main_body: wooden coal bin with an open top filled with a mound of coal
top_band: rows 5-10 form the foreshortened wooden top rim (with the coal mound rising from row 3 to row 9 inside the opening, and a light brown front rim across row 10)
evidence: Reading column 7 downward: rows 3-9 show the dark grey/black coal pile inside the top opening (bounded by the wooden side rims in rows 5-9), row 10 is a distinct light-brown front rim edge, row 11 is a dark-brown shadow row beneath the rim, and rows 12-15 form the vertical front face with an inset medium-brown panel at rows 12-14.

style.evidence: While the outer wood outline uses a dark brown material tone, the surfaces lack Beodeul's texture and shading richness: the front rim (row 10) and inset panel (cols 5-9, rows 12-14) are completely flat uniform colour fills with no wood grain or plank shading, and the coal pile is mostly a solid near-black fill with only two isolated grey pixels inside instead of individually shaded coal chunks.
